text: Completed the idiomatic DMS acceptance scenario. Public formula owns sample/delay/probe phases, term-specific timing, FIR/SPMG bases, within-cell RT centering, missingness, empty-cell policy, and separate-runs fixed effects. Public semantic hypotheses cover sample/delay windows, probe at-time and interaction, RT slope, noncanonical probe F, delay FIR F, plus typed empty-cell non-estimability. Added typed DatasetEvents.fromColumns and safe inferred-run FmriDataset.open so the scenario contains no unsafe row assembly, column offsets, integer contrast vectors, label parsing, or external centering. Independent live-source R receipt records fmridesign 0.6.0 and fmrihrf 0.4.0 revisions, design/response/rank/df/T/F outputs and accepted upstream boundaries; manifest validator and executable docs updated. Corrected F reduced-axis projection and fmrihrf-compatible linear-hat microtime projection; regenerated affected R corpora. Evidence: dataset DatasetEventsSuite JVM/JS 6/6; focused HRF 15/15 and fit 12/12 per platform; final tools/ci/first-level-gate.sh passed scenario-testkit 3, HRF 210, HRF laws 77, design 227, model 27, fit 197 on each JVM/JS platform; manifest validated 29 entries; diff check clean.
